csv_project_name: Consulting Services for Metropolitan Transportation Plan2055
csv_scope_of_work: The Rocky Mount Urban Area MPO seeks consultant support to prepare the 2055 Metropolitan Transportation Plan (MTP) that complies with all applicable federal regulations. These plans will guide coordinated, long-range transportation planning consistent with federal and NCDOT requirements. Suggested alternate language: The MTP will serve as the federally-required, fiscally constrained long-range transportation plan for the MPO planning area. Plans will address a minimum 20-year planning horizon and incorporating both long- range and short range multimodal strategies to meet current and future transportation demand
csv_disciplines_requested: Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning

title: Consulting Services for Metropolitan Transportation Plan 2055
short_description: Consulting services for a long-range metropolitan transportation plan update in Rocky Mount.
project_scope: Preparation of the 2055 Metropolitan Transportation Plan for the Rocky Mount Urban Area MPO as the federally required, fiscally constrained long-range transportation plan for the MPO planning area. The plan must comply with applicable federal regulations and NCDOT requirements, cover at least a 20-year planning horizon, and include both long-range and short-range multimodal strategies to address current and future transportation demand.
services: Transportation planning, public transit planning, planning/master planning, consultant support for metropolitan transportation plan preparation.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure transportation planning/master planning assignment without structural or engineering design scope.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure component identified.
- Falls under urban/open space/feasibility-style planning categories that are generally not relevant for sbp.
- No planning component for structural design, civil engineering structures, or HOAI-like design phases.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction works or construction budget stated. The notice concerns preparation of a metropolitan transportation plan only; no project-specific physical scope, quantities, or capital cost are provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information stated. As this is a planning consultancy for an MPO transportation plan, no explicit engineering fee relevant to sbp is provided.
contracting_authority: City of Rocky Mount, Rocky Mount, NC, USA. Contact: Fantashia Dickens. Phone: 252-972-1352. Fax: 252-972-1662. Email: fantashia.dickens@rockymountnc.gov. Website: https://www.rockymountnc.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=128
notes: Questions deadline: 06/03/2026 02:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goal: MWBE/HUB 10%. Solicitation documents available online. Although the fixed category list does not fit this planning-only procurement well, it has been assigned to Road Bridges as the closest transportation-related category.
